design.startup_scope: recorded launch-to-ready probe; not lifecycle elapsed time or a request

interpretation.accounting: Requested host-to-device bytes names the existing h2d_bytes application counter (128811927312 per lifecycle), not measured physical bus traffic. Reader totals are 128811263616 bytes; equal across modes, not to one another
interpretation.bootstrap: Exact 3125 paired-block resamples; nearest ranks 79 and 3047; descriptive, not coverage-guaranteed
interpretation.cache: Shared NFS client, not physical NAS traffic. Fresh servers do not establish cold caches. Phase totals include bytes between request windows
interpretation.limitations: One instrumented n=5 study; no significance, power, repetition-based confidence, physical-release or physical-backend-I/O claim
interpretation.memory: Logical host-reservation maximum and device-wide sampled maximum; separate scopes, not RSS or exact process-owned GPU bytes. Do not add gauges or sum lifetime peaks
interpretation.quality: 900 worker-enqueued tokens: 110 exact eight-token oracle requests and 10 length-only two-token smoke requests; SSE events are not tokens
interpretation.wait: Sum host demand_wait_ns per invocation within a measured request, then median of five requests per arm; not GPU overlap or a causal latency decomposition

qualified_goodput_tokens_per_second.interpretation: exploratory descriptive interval; no coverage/significance/power claim

request_e2e_seconds.interpretation: exploratory descriptive interval; no coverage/significance/power claim

ttft_seconds.interpretation: exploratory descriptive interval; no coverage/significance/power claim

provenance.device_sample_scope: Checked public collector-summary maxima and counts; raw device sample streams are not in the public archive
provenance.privacy_policy: Only public archive members; no private inputs or private derivation imports
provenance.time_policy: No analysis timestamp; only bound recorded measurements
provenance.verification: check.verify: every public member, compressed and expanded hashes, original pins, full reconstruction and bootstrap enumeration
